Now let's look at the fence callers: Panel.js, flow.js, editor/page.js, editor/blocks.js, Draggable/page.js, Item/page.js, List/page.js, and PageLog.Reader (Log.js) for naming alignment, plus ext/Draggable/Sortable.js and ext/JSONL/live.js and the dev Socket module.

Both commits landed. Here's the summary.

**What got built** (the design moved three times under me — second pass → third pass → fourth/final pass — and I rebuilt against the final one, "a list is a property, not a parent"):

- [`core/Events/Events.js`](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/core/Events/) — new `on`/`off`/`emit` mixin with a `bubbles()` boundary hook.
- [`core/List/List.js`](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/core/List/) — renamed `children`→`items`, added `forEach`/`map`/`at`, kept `each`/`.children` as back-compat aliases.
- `core/List/LiveList.js` (new) — the list that announces every change: `add`/`remove`/`move`/`order` by id, each emitting the line it would save plus one uniform `"delta"` event.
- [`core/Item/Item.js`](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/core/Item/) (rewritten) — `id`, `data`, `get`/`put`, one `set(delta)`, `view`. No list methods at all — a class that needs children gives *itself* a named `LiveList` property.
- `core/Item/Store.js` (new) — listens for `"delta"` on an attached host, computes the path from host to wherever the change happened, appends one line; replay rebuilds the same tree.
- Callers adapted: `Panel.js`, `flow.js`, `Workspace.js`, `Sortable.js`, the editor (`page.js`/`blocks.js`), `Draggable/page.js`, and the `Item`/`List` demo pages.

**Proof, not just claims:**
- `test.mjs` (node, no DOM): **32/32 passing**.
- Headless Playwright smoke across Panel, editor, Draggable, Item, List: **zero JS errors** (two pre-existing/benign 404s on Panel/editor — no saved doc yet on this fresh worktree, unrelated).
- Screenshots confirm real rendering (Panel workspace, editor canvas+layers+properties).
- One drag gesture on the Draggable demo visibly reordered two rows — the full drag→`move`→redraw pipeline works live.

**Not done:** `core/Item/readme.md` and `core/List/readme.md` still describe the old shape (out of my fence — a documentation pass should refresh them before the docs-check). `core/Page/*` untouched, as instructed — that's minion B's.

## Summary

**page-on-item landed.** `Page extends PageLog extends Item` is in, in the worktree `C:\Code\lew42\worktrees\page-extends-item`, 11 commits, all 12 deliverables shipped:

- **Core**: `page.pages` (a real `LiveList`) + `page.children` (a Map-shaped view over it, so ~215 existing callers never changed), `page.content` made lazily and drawn by one reusable `render_content_list()`, `PageLog.Reader extends Item.Store`, `page.file()` splits its replay path from its code path (returns a file), `Page.Store` → `Page.Prefs`/`page.prefs()`.
- **Demo**: [`/framework/core/Item/live/`](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/core/Item/live/) — add, drag, sort, reload: the list comes back, a live tail of the file's own last lines. Screenshots at 400/1920 in this task's `shots/`.
- **Census + cleanup**: `ai2`'s card `items` → `outline_items`; one real naming collision found and fixed (`imagine/youtube/marks/page.js`'s own `emit()`); `ext/filesystem`'s `FsDir` → `Dir`.
- **Proof**: Minion A's 32/32 unit tests still pass; a 13-page headless smoke is clean except 3 pre-existing, unrelated failures (confirmed and documented); live interaction tests (add+reload, sort writes one line, a second tab sees a change in under 2s, reset batches into one write) all pass.

**Three real regressions turned up only under a running browser**, fixed same day: `naming()` never actually set a page's `id` (so every added child was unfindable by name); `Page.jsonl()`'s new caching raced with the page system's own eager child-crawl and corrupted a shared reader; the `children` setter silently ignored a live reset the page generator depends on. All three are now fixed and re-verified.

Full detail, decisions and the regression write-ups are in the [task log](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ai/2026-10-02/page-extends-item/page-on-item/) and `core/Page/doc/decisions.md`'s new dated section. Next steps (fresh-mastermind docs-check, fresh-eyes review, merge) belong to the parent task, per the minion build order.

**Report (5 lines):**

1. **Tail**: rewritten as one truncated (ellipsis, never mid-word) line per entry in the site's normal `--ink`-on-`--surface` text — the old colour was `--code-ink`, meant only for `pre`'s own dark background, left on a light one.
2. **Buttons**: the shared `wrap` utility class was beating my own CSS (util layer always wins) — removed it; all four sit on one row from 1200 up, grouped two-by-two on purpose under 36em.
3. **Tab/rail order**: `children: "live"` ran through `declare()` before Doc's own `initialize()` added Overview/API/Docs/Files — fixed by chaining Doc's `initialize()` first, so Overview leads everywhere now.
4. **Width**: the whole demo was capped at the 40em reading column regardless of viewport (`.wide` added to opt out) — rows keep that 40em measure on purpose, the tail grows beside them to a 64em cap; one block, not two islands.
5. **Drag proof** added (`pei-b-drag.mjs`): a real pointer drag writes exactly one `move` line. Re-ran `layout-check` at 400/1200/1920/3440, reviewed every shot, committed as `ac12818c`.
Fixed — `pre`'s default UA margin was the gap; tail is now a tight log (1.5 line-height, zero gap between entries), committed as `32c8b1ad`.
